questions.stem: Engineer 1 reviews a bridge bay and asks about Hearing a melodic interval and the two lines that give it

options.text: The interval is the pitch distance between two notes sounded in succession
The interval is the distance between two notes sounded at the same time

questions.learningObjective: State the rule for Sizing a harmonic interval between two sounding notes
questions.stem: Engineer 46 reads a bridge data table about Sizing a harmonic interval between two sounding notes

options.text: Count the notes played in sequence
options.misconception: treats simultaneous notes as a melody

options.text: Count the difference in loudness
Count the number of instruments
options.misconception: mistakes ensemble size for interval size

options.text: Count the semitones between the two sounding notes

questions.explanation: Counting semitones between the two sounding notes sizes the harmonic interval. Sequence, loudness, or ensemble size are wrong.

questions.subject: MUSIC_THEORY
questions.topic: What an inversion does to an interval's number and quality
questions.learningObjective: State the rule for What an inversion does to an interval's number and quality
questions.stem: Engineer 47 writes a brief note explaining What an inversion does to an interval's number and quality

answer.exemplar: Inversion sets the new number to nine minus the original and flips the quality, so a major third becomes a minor sixth and a perfect fifth becomes a perfect fourth.

questions.explanation: Inversion sets the new number to nine minus the original and flips the quality. A major third becomes a minor sixth and a perfect fifth becomes a perfect fourth.

questions.explanation: The inverted perfect fifth spans five semitones, a perfect fourth, keeping perfect colour. Five is the inverted size.

questions.subject: MUSIC_THEORY
questions.topic: Sizing the inversion of a perfect fifth
questions.learningObjective: State the rule for Sizing the inversion of a perfect fifth
questions.stem: Engineer 49 reviews a bridge bay and asks about Sizing the inversion of a perfect fifth

options.text: 5 semitones
7 semitones
6 semitones
4 semitones
options.misconception: mistakes major third for inverted fifth

questions.explanation: The inversion of a perfect fifth is five semitones, a perfect fourth. Seven, six, or four are different intervals.

questions.subject: MUSIC_THEORY
questions.topic: Why a tritone resolves differently from a fourth
questions.learningObjective: State the rule for Why a tritone resolves differently from a fourth
questions.stem: Engineer 50 reads a bridge data table about Why a tritone resolves differently from a fourth

options.text: Both are equally stable
The fourth resolves, the tritone stays
Neither resolves
The tritone is unstable and resolves, unlike the fourth

questions.explanation: The tritone is unstable and resolves, unlike the perfect fourth. Equal stability, reversed tendency, or no resolution are wrong.

questions.topic: Measuring how far a tritone widens as it resolves
questions.learningObjective: State the rule for Measuring how far a tritone widens as it resolves
questions.stem: Engineer 51 writes a brief note explaining Measuring how far a tritone widens as it resolves

answer.exemplar: The augmented fourth of six semitones resolves outward to a perfect fifth of seven, widening by one semitone; the diminished fifth resolves inward to a perfect fourth of five.

questions.explanation: The augmented fourth of six semitones resolves outward to a perfect fifth of seven, widening by one semitone. The diminished fifth resolves inward to a perfect fourth of five.

questions.stem: Engineer 52 computes a value for Why the perfect fifth is a stable interval
questions.explanation: The perfect fifth spans seven semitones and is stable because of its simple frequency ratio. Seven is its size.

options.text: Major sixth is 9 semitones, wider than minor

questions.subject: MUSIC_THEORY
questions.topic: Why a diminished seventh chord is ambiguous
questions.learningObjective: State the rule for Why a diminished seventh chord is ambiguous
questions.stem: Engineer 55 writes a brief note explaining Why a diminished seventh chord is ambiguous

answer.exemplar: Its notes can be respelled as leading tones in several keys, so the same chord may resolve to different tonics; that multiplicity of possible resolutions creates the ambiguity.

questions.explanation: Its notes can be respelled as leading tones in several keys, so the same chord may resolve to different tonics. That multiplicity of possible resolutions creates the ambiguity.

questions.stem: Engineer 56 computes a value for Sizing a diminished seventh between its outer notes
questions.explanation: The outer notes of a diminished seventh chord span nine semitones. That is its total size from root to diminished seventh.

questions.subject: MUSIC_THEORY
questions.topic: Hearing a melodic interval and the two lines that give it
questions.learningObjective: State the rule for Hearing a melodic interval and the two lines that give it
questions.stem: Engineer 57 reviews a bridge bay and asks about Hearing a melodic interval and the two lines that give it

options.text: The interval is the pitch of the first note alone
options.misconception: treats the interval as only one melodic line

options.text: The interval is the rhythm between the two notes regardless of pitch
options.misconception: reduces pitch distance to timing alone

options.text: The interval is the distance between two notes sounded at the same time
options.misconception: confuses melodic succession with harmonic simultaneity

options.text: The interval is the pitch distance between two notes sounded in succession

questions.explanation: A melodic interval is the pitch distance between two notes sounded in succession. A single line, rhythm, or harmony are different ideas.
